title: LastLineControl
description: Fly and God mode management with item pickup restriction for fair gameplay.
body:
**LastLineControl** is a powerful and lightweight tool for Minecraft server administrators that provides full control over Flight and God modes. The plugin is specifically designed for Survival and Grief servers where maintaining game balance and fairness is crucial.

### Key Features:

**Item Pickup Prevention:** Players can no longer hover up resources while `/fly` or `/god` is active. As soon as a player starts flying or becomes invincible, item pickup is automatically blocked.

**Smart GameMode Integration:** The plugin automatically recognizes Creative (GM 1) and Spectator (GM 3) modes - no extra configuration needed.

**Creative Mode Support:** In Creative mode, `/fly` acts as a toggle for standard flight, and item pickup remains enabled to not interfere with building.

**ActionBar Notifications:** Instead of spamming the chat, the plugin displays neat, non-intrusive warnings right above the hotbar.

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/fly` | Toggle flight mode for yourself | `lastline.fly` |
| `/fly <player>` | Toggle flight mode for a player | `lastline.admin` |
| `/god` | Toggle god mode for yourself | `lastline.god` |
| `/god <player>` | Toggle god mode for a player | `lastline.admin` |
| `/llc reload` | Reload plugin configuration | `lastline.admin` |
